Definition: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of G4260; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively):--sheep(-fold).
BiblicalUsage: Probaton is the sheep, and Scripture makes it the picture of God's people. Jesus sends his disciples as sheep in the midst of wolves, and says the good shepherd gives his life for the sheep. John hears the promise that his sheep hear his voice and follow him, and Peter says we were as sheep going astray but are now returned to the Shepherd of our souls.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sheep picture is both comfort and charge: comfort, because the Shepherd lays down his life for us, and charge, because sheep that hear his voice must follow. I am his sheep, and I know his voice.
RelatedEvents: The Good Shepherd; The Lost Sheep
